description: This file defines a PHP trait named CryptoParamsTraitV2 within the AWS SDK for PHP, specifically for the S3 Crypto namespace. It provides a method to retrieve a materials provider that implements the MaterialsProviderInterfaceV2 interface, enforcing type checking and throwing an exception if the provider is invalid.

methods.name: getMaterialsProvider
methods.description: Retrieves the materials provider from the given arguments, ensuring it implements MaterialsProviderInterfaceV2 and throws an exception otherwise.
